declaration.negotiation_history_statement: I submit this statement in support of preliminary approval under Rule 23(e). Counsel negotiated the class relief and attorneys’ fees during the same settlement discussions; fees were not deferred until after agreement on class relief. The resulting settlement provides a $30 million class fund, distributed automatically to approximately 400,000 identified members without a claims process. Brightline will pay up to $5 million in attorneys’ fees and expenses separately, subject to court approval. There is no clear-sailing provision, and any amount not awarded as fees will go to the class rather than revert to Brightline. The settlement provides certain, prompt relief in light of the risks of class certification, trial, and delay. I do not recount confidential mediation offers or communications here.
